description: The earlier approved OTH-001 rule could be read as making utterance-act anchoring invariably speaker/writer-centred. Chapter 17 §1.1 p. 1453 explicitly describes reader-centred and reported-perspective exceptions.
proposed_resolution: RESOLVED with the owner's blanket approval: qualify OTH-001 as ordinarily speaker-centred, record shifted-centre cases in OTH-009/OTH-010, and keep the historical overlap in the conflict log.
approval: Owner expressly approved all required Chapter 17 changes on 2026-11-05.
